# Demo tool

Turns a folder of synthetic sample cases into a one-page summary report.

![Report screenshot](docs/screenshot.png)

## Try it

```bash
python -m demo_tool --sample
```

Or open the live demo: https://demo.example/

## My role

I designed and wrote all of it.

## Tech stack

Python 3.12, pytest.

## Limitations

Only reads CSV files. No login, no database.
